title: hemerocallis citrina var. vespertina
intro: Hemerocallis citrina var. vespertina, commonly known as the golden daylily, is a variety of flowering plant in the Hemerocallis genus. This plant is known for its golden-yellow flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving liver function, and aiding in the treatment of fever. The therapeutic actions of Hemerocallis citrina var. vespertina are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, saponins, and sesquiterpenes, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects of this plant on human health.
